# obot_git_credentials (Data Source)

Lists Git credentials, sorted by ID, with the objects that use each one. Tokens are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "obot_git_credentials" "all" {}

# Display names need not be unique, so list each credential with its ID.
output "git_credentials" {
  value = [
    for credential in data.obot_git_credentials.all.credentials : {
      id           = credential.id
      display_name = credential.display_name
      host         = credential.host
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Git credentials. An installation with none returns an empty list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `host` (String) Git host the credential is used for.
- `id` (String) The generated Obot Git credential ID, for a catalog source's `git_credential_id`.
- `token_configured` (Boolean) Whether Obot has a token stored for the credential. The token itself is never returned.
- `used_by` (Attributes List) Objects that read sources with the credential, as last recorded by Obot. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials--used_by))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials--used_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials.used_by`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The object's display name.
- `id` (String) The object's ID, such as `default` for the default MCP catalog.
- `type` (String) Kind of object: `mcp_catalog`, `system_mcp_catalog`, or `skill_repository`.
